claim_core.statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) having exactly227 actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets counted once, let r_T count those containing actual triangle T and put d_T=6-r_T. All deficiencies are zero, one, two or three. If a,b,c count deficiency-one, deficiency-two and deficiency-three triangles, respectively, then a+2b+3c=24 and precisely the following necessary population ranges hold: c=0 with 1<=b<=8 and a=24-2b; c=1 with 0<=b<=5 and a=21-2b; or c=2 with b in {0,1} and a=18-2b. No c>=3 occurs. This does not assert realizability of a listed population, exclude count227 or resolve the target.

Local degree parity and actual fan injection give even r1+r3 and P>=3r1+5r2+7r3.
For c>=2, actual d3 triangles are disjoint with star degree3,1,1,1 at every point. Known edges and full target Q PSD exclude c3/c4; crossmatching cap3 gives c2,b<=1.
For c1,b>=3 stars supply9 distinct d1 triangles; b6 saturates all6 external d2 triangle points and violates unique d1 defect degree, so b<=5.
For c0, b>=1; b12 fails fan/outer-mass, b11/b10 fail even-two/four, b9 produces an induced rook from even-six.

Full99 Q indicator equality, also independent90 boundary-edge saturation, gives exactly one rook neighbor at every outside vertex; distinct-root d2 cannot share outerpoints and has no defect partners there.
Sixteen rows are retained necessary possibilities only; no feasibility or target resolution is inferred.
